sn1.71:1.2: Standing to one side, that devatā addressed the Blessed One in verse:
sn1.71:2.1: “Having slain what does one sleep soundly?
sn1.71:2.2: Having slain what does one not sorrow?
sn1.71:2.3: What is the one thing, O Gotama,
sn1.71:2.4: Whose killing you approve?” [The Blessed One:
sn1.71:3.2: Having slain anger, one does not sorrow;
sn1.71:3.3: The killing of anger, O devatā,
sn1.71:3.4: With its poisoned root and honeyed tip:
sn1.71:3.5: This is the killing the noble ones praise,
sn1.71:3.6: For having slain that, one does not sorrow.”
